text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Greek Cypriot newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Glafcos Clerides insists on demilitarisation in a letter to Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash.
- Cooperation between centre-right Diko and right-wing Disy in municipal elections is to be clarified next week.
- The taxpayer is forking out one million pounds a year to protect the underworld.
- Education ministry wants a greater say in the running of the Cyprus University.
- Russia's foreign minister sends a letter to Clerides through Akel party chief Demetris Christofias.
- Party bickering blocks the appointment of a new Cyprus Airways chairman.
- Russian criminals are believed to be behind a Limassol bomb explosion which critically injured one man this week.
- Proximity talks start on a military dialogue.
